title: Multispin Physics of AI Tipping Points and Hallucinations

bias_targets.methodology: Modeling generative AI attention mechanisms as a multispin thermal system to mathematically calculate and predict 'tipping points' where outputs suddenly shift from benign to harmful or biased content based on embedding space similarities shaped by training data.

Theoretically applying the derived multispin physical formulas to evaluate how generative models transition between opposing camps of thought (e.g., 'woke' vs. 'non-woke' content) during text generation.
